definitions.short: a covering (in a bad sense), i.e. blindness or obduracy
definitions.full: H4044. meginnah מְגִנָּה noun feminine covering , מְגִנַּתלֵֿב Lam 3:65 covering of heart , i.e. a hard shell about the heart = obstinacy , so Ges (compare Qor 6:25 ) RV; or, covering of the understanding, blindness of the heart , so Ew Ke Näg Che.
